newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine court bans sale of oil firm YPF shares.
newsitem.headline: Argentine court bans sale of oil firm YPF shares.

text.p: An Argentine court banned Monday the planned sale of 10 percent of the shares of local oil firm YPF that are in the hands of the company's employees, press reports said Tuesday.
The ruling of a labor judge upholds a claim of some 1,000 former YPF's employees that argue they were left out from the operation, Clarin and Ambito Financiero newspapers said.
The cut-off price for the auction of the YPF shares will be announced at 1015 local time (0915 New York) Tuesday, an executive for a local bank handling the auction said Monday.
Banco Comafi and MBA in Argentina and Salomon Brothers in New York have been accepting bids for the shares since 1700 local time Monday.
Argentina's government authorized the sale of the 33.5 million Class C YPF shares in the hands of the company's employees --10 percent of the firm's stock -- by a decree issued last Friday.
The government owns another 20 percent of the firm but says it has no immediate plans to sell.
